Take your Phrozen Arco off Buster.

The factory stack is frozen at Debian Buster and Klipper v0.11, and Buster is end-of-life. This puts the printer on Debian Bookworm with Klipper v0.13 — and keeps the serial touch display, both MCUs, the chamber light, input shaper, the optional AMS and the PhrozenGo app working.

  • Debian Bookworm · kernel 6.18
  • Klipper v0.13
  • Mainsail + Fluidd
  • Full SSH / root
  • AGPL-3.0

Before you flash anything. Two things on a factory Arco cannot be downloaded again once the eMMC is overwritten: the AMS server files, and your own calibration. Both are rescued in Step 1 of the manual — do that first, on the printer while it still boots.
